messages:
zoe: spinning up canary for meridian8b-int4. quick smoke shows weird off-by-month date math in planning prompts (e.g., add 6 months to Aug 31 -> Mar 2). posting samples.
matt: run id? config?
zoe: run meridian-canary-6181, config: microbatch=300k, max_new_tokens=200, prefetch=on, quant=perchannel-int4. sample prompt: "If you add 6 months to Aug 31, 2026 what is the resulting date?"
  int4: "March 2, 2027" (wrong)
  fp32 baseline: "Feb 28, 2027"
hannah: date arithmetic errors often point to subtle precision shifts in positional embeddings or softmax sharpness. can we dump logits and tokenization boundaries for the example?
zoe: attached minimal repro output (logits top3 + tokens). also saw a kernel mismatch warning once: 
```
[2026-03-23T16:22:10Z] WARN kernel-selector: using fallback dotprod-small for layer 5
```
matt: small plan: 1) try layer-protect first 1 layer fp16, 2) re-run quant-cali using kl+mse and include a date/math focused calibration set, 3) temporarily reduce max_new_tokens default from 200->100 for meridian until we understand.
hannah: also add a focused eval metric 'date-exact' (exact match for canonical date outputs). gate onboarding on that.
infra-bot: canary deploy started: meridian-canary-6181 -> nodes [gpu-c3-09], routing 5% traffic, trace-sample=2%
zoe: i'll kick the targeted calib and post results. if kernel fallback repeats we should pin kernel image or evict that node from pool.
matt: agree. also try prefetch=off AB test; it sometimes reduces ephemeral allocation noise which can affect quantized softmax.
zoe: kicked off calib run (calib-meridian-6181b). will report back in ~20m. thanks all :thumbsup:
